text_block_list.text:
For Orfevre, it was her second Arima 
Kinen... Just like last year, Nakayama 
Racecourse was roaring with excitement.

However,
there is one decisive difference. 
The only thing burning brightly is a 
single cheer—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: "Orfeeeeevre!! Orfeeeee~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainers
text_block_list.text:
"Lady Orfevre...! Bring us victory! An 
overwhelming, thorough victory...!"

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Fans
text_block_list.text: Lady Orfeeeeevvvre!! Rule over meeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Crazy as always... Or rather, it feels 
like she's gotten even stronger.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
—I suppose the hoofprints Orfe has left 
behind so far are what make them feel
that 
way.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ! Journey-san...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Or walked the path befitting a king. 
Behold—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Orfe-san...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to learn from you. Show me the 
way you—the King—achieve victory.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"It seems the Umamusume who will shape
the 
future have been deeply influenced as 
well."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
From here on, Or will surely become a 
target for everyone to strive toward.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...I suppose so.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Are you... satisfied with that?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Even though you viewed her as such a
rival 
during the Classic Year.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...! T-That's...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, Journey-san, why are you paying 
attention to me anyway?"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I know. ...That it's not for my sake, at 
least.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I'm injured right now,
and yet... ...Can I 
still really be of any use to that person?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
How tragic... Please do not look at it in 
such a cynical light.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Didn't I tell you before? I believe in 
your strength.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, you are... right here, right 
now. Don't you think that is an answer in 
itself?"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Come... it won't be long now.
Looking upon 
that light will surely clear your doubts—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Orfeeeeee! Waaaaahhh...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Gah,
not good enough! Golshi Cheer Squad, 
fire it up more!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Geez! Today was definitely supposed to be 
Golshi-chan's special day! How dare you 
hijack it?!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It cannot be helped. She is, after all, 
the undisputed champion right now.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Golshi-san. Right now, rank doesn't 
matter. Let us challenge her simply to 
defeat her."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
We must bring all our forces to bear and 
crush that monarchy. —Otherwise, there is 
no future for us.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
—Hurry, hurry! I wonder if Orfevre is 
coming out yet.
I bet she'll be super cool 
today too.

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you really are a huge fan of hers, 
aren't you? ...Let's cheer our hearts out 
for her from right here!

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'm sure it'll reach her! Orfevre, 
do your best~~!!

The thunderous cheers awaiting their king 
reach all the way here... yet with just a 
single word, she can dispel all that 
overwhelming force.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Rejoice.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"I shall grant today's victory as a
reward 
unto you."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
It's just a whim. I have more than enough 
crowns to spare...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I suppose I could bestow at least one
upon 
you.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
It might be a bit too heavy to serve as a 
staff, though.
choice_data_list: It has a weight worthy of standing...
It's a weight fitting enough to st...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hoh.
choice_data_list: It's a fitting weight to bear if I...
It carries just the right weight f...

text_block_list.text: (Waaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: "...Heh. Very well, let me show you."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
The majesty of a king, ruling both past 
and future.
